en.title: Follow the Flower
en.description: A flower held overhead marks the way for the group.

zh.title: 队伍前面的一朵花
zh.description: 路口有人把一朵花举高，队伍跟在后面。

en.title: Between the Hedges
en.description: Tall clipped hedges flank a shaded walkway as visitors follow the path toward a bright opening.

zh.title: 树篱夹道
zh.description: 两排修剪整齐的高树篱夹出阴凉步道，游人沿路走向远处的亮处。

en.title: Red Tape, Green Slope
en.description: Red-and-white tape crosses the green slope below the hilltop pavilion.

zh.title: 草坡上的红白线
zh.description: 草坡上拉着红白警戒带，远处是美泉宫的观景楼。

en.title: An Opening in the Hedges
en.description: Small figures cross a patch of light between tall hedges.

zh.title: 树篱留的一道光
zh.description: 高大的树篱之间，几个人影走过亮处。

en.title: The Platform Opposite
en.description: A bright rectangle frames two people on the opposite platform.

zh.title: 对面站台
zh.description: 暗处的窗口里，框着对面站台上的两个人。

en.title: Path Across the Slope
en.description: A gravel path climbs the green slope past red-and-white barrier tape, with the hilltop pavilion just visible.

zh.title: 草坡小径
zh.description: 碎石小径贴着绿坡向上，红白警戒带拦在草丛里，坡顶露出观景楼的轮廓。

en.title: Waiting for Someone to Run Past
en.description: I waited by these cherry trees until someone ran across the petal-covered path.

zh.title: 等一个人跑过
zh.description: 为了这几株樱花等了很久，终于有人跑过花瓣铺着的小路。

en.title: Swans Past the Bridge Arch
en.description: The bridge's dark arch fills half the frame as people on the stone steps watch two swans drift past.

zh.title: 桥洞外的天鹅
zh.description: 桥洞的阴影占去半边画面，石阶上坐着几个人，看两只天鹅贴着水面游过。

en.title: Lawn by the Glasshouse
en.description: The long glasshouse front faces the sky while people stretch out across the broad lawn before it.

zh.title: 温室前的草坪
zh.description: 玻璃温室的长立面映着天光，门前大草坪上到处是躺着晒太阳的人。

en.title: The Bicycle Rests Too
en.description: Someone sits on the lawn beside a bicycle and a bed of flowers.

zh.title: 自行车也休息
zh.description: 一个人坐在草地上，自行车倒在身旁，花坛就在脚边。

en.title: The Statue Stays Standing
en.description: People stretch out on the grass in front of the equestrian statue.

zh.title: 铜像负责站着
zh.description: 骑马铜像前，人们已经在草地上躺下。

en.title: Room on the Lawn
en.description: Small groups spread across the lawn below a white statue.

zh.title: 树下各躺各的
zh.description: 树下的草坪上散着几组人，远处站着一座白色雕像。

en.title: Horseman on the Square
en.description: A green bronze horseman rears before a long pink palace facade, the people below reduced to specks.

zh.title: 广场上的骑马像
zh.description: 绿色骑马铜像扬起前蹄，背景是浅粉色的宫殿长楼，草地上的人小得只剩影子。

en.title: Riders Before the Dome
en.description: Under a streaked cloudy sky, the museum's green dome looms behind dark silhouetted equestrian statues.

zh.title: 穹顶前的骑像
zh.description: 多云天空下，博物馆的绿色穹顶压着广场，前景骑马铜像只剩深色剪影。

en.title: Behind the Flower Counter
en.description: The florist stands among bouquets, loose stems and a counter full of flowers.

zh.title: 花店柜台后
zh.description: 围裙、花束和铺满柜台的花材，店员站在它们中间。

en.title: Reflections on the Glass Grid
en.description: Steel mullions divide the glass facade into a grid, warping the reflection of the older facades across from it.

zh.title: 玻璃幕墙上的楼影
zh.description: 玻璃幕墙被钢架划成方格，对面老楼的影子折在格子里，随玻璃微微起伏。

en.title: Graffiti Underpass Entrance
en.description: The underpass walls are layered with graffiti while pedestrians cross the plaza above and around it.

zh.title: 涂鸦地道口
zh.description: 地道入口的矮墙涂满层层叠叠的涂鸦，广场上的人三三两两从它身边走过。

en.title: Waiting at the Crossing
en.description: Tram tracks angle through the intersection where a small knot of pedestrians waits beneath the signal poles.

zh.title: 等灯的路口
zh.description: 电车轨道斜过路口，信号灯杆下站着一小撮行人，背后墙上贴满海报。

en.title: Crossing, Eyes on Phone
en.description: Between tall old facades, a pedestrian strides across the street looking down at a phone.

zh.title: 低头过街
zh.description: 窄街被两旁老楼夹紧，一个行人边看手机边迈步穿过路口。

en.title: There Is Room on the Grass
en.description: People sit and lie across a broad lawn surrounded by trees.

zh.title: 草坪还有位置
zh.description: 大草坪上坐着、躺着许多人，树冠在四周围成一圈。

en.title: VR, on Location
en.description: The monument is right there; several visitors are looking through VR headsets.

zh.title: 来现场戴上VR
zh.description: 纪念柱就在面前，几位游客却戴着VR眼镜看它。

en.title: Where the Wave Breaks
en.description: White surf breaks around the ochre rocks.

zh.title: 浪到这里散开
zh.description: 白色浪花沿着黄褐色的礁石散开。

en.title: Pines on the Rocky Slope
en.description: Two pines lean seaward on a stony slope while small figures stand along the ridge line taking in the view.

zh.title: 岩坡上的松树
zh.description: 碎石坡上两棵松树歪向海的方向，坡顶站着几个小小的人影朝远处看。

en.title: Path Down to the Sea
en.description: A dirt path threads through flowering grass past a lone tree as two walkers head toward the hazy sea.

zh.title: 通往海边的土路
zh.description: 土路从花草丛里穿过去，绕过那棵孤零零的大树，两个行人走向雾蒙蒙的海。

en.title: Night Steps
en.description: One figure climbs a lamplit stone staircase between empty cafe tables.

zh.title: 夜巷石阶
zh.description: 路灯照亮一段上坡石阶，一人正拾级而上，两侧桌椅空着。

en.title: Court Above the Roofs
en.description: A small court sits among old-town rooftops, with one person crossing it alone.

zh.title: 红屋顶球场
zh.description: 小球场嵌在老城屋顶之间，一个人正从场中走过。

en.title: Hillside Overlook
en.description: Two people sit on a grassy, rocky slope above the rooftops and bay.

zh.title: 山坡上看海
zh.description: 两人坐在草坡岩石上，面朝山下红顶老城与海湾。

en.title: On the City Wall
en.description: Two people walk along a narrow stone rampart path that turns ahead.

zh.title: 城墙上的两个人
zh.description: 两个人沿着石砌城墙前行，狭窄的步道在前方转弯。

en.title: Car in the Grass
en.description: A dark sedan sits abandoned in tall grass against layered mountains.

zh.title: 草丛里的旧车
zh.description: 一辆深色轿车弃置在山谷草丛中，背后山峦层叠。

en.title: Orange Curtain
en.description: Orange curtains frame the window, partly hidden by the passengers in front.

zh.title: 橘色窗帘
zh.description: 橘色窗帘垂在车窗旁，乘客的背影挡住了窗外的一角。

en.title: Floodlight Tower
en.description: A floodlight array and its lattice support stand against the dark sky.

zh.title: 夜里的灯架
zh.description: 矩形投光灯阵列立在金属塔架上，四周是一整片黑色夜空。

en.title: Chasing a Pigeon
en.description: A child runs across the lawn toward a pigeon below a stone church wall.

zh.title: 草地追鸽
zh.description: 小孩在石墙前的草坪上跑向一只鸽子，大人远远站着。

en.title: End of the Pier
en.description: People sit scattered at the stone pier's end, a cruise ship offshore.

zh.title: 码头尽头
zh.description: 石质码头伸入蓝色海面，几人散坐尽头，远处有邮轮。

en.title: Bench Facing the Peaks
en.description: Two people on a white bench face the distant snow-lined ridge.

zh.title: 长椅与雪山
zh.description: 两人坐在白色长椅上背对镜头，望向远处积雪的山脊。

en.title: Frames in the Field
en.description: White frames stand in a field beneath layered green ridges.

zh.title: 田里的白色架子
zh.description: 白色架子立在田里，背后是层叠的绿色山脊。

en.title: Forty on the Balcony
en.description: An orange house bears a round 40 sign beside a decorated branch.

zh.title: 阳台上的40
zh.description: 橘色房子挂着一个40的圆牌，门边还有装饰过的树枝。

en.title: Doors Beneath the Arch
en.description: Light comes through the wooden doors at the end of a tiled hall.

zh.title: 拱顶下的木门
zh.description: 拱顶大厅尽头的木门透着光，地砖一路铺到门前。

en.title: Sketching by the Lake
en.description: A seated figure sketches at the lakeside, silhouetted against the water.

zh.title: 湖边画画的人
zh.description: 一个人坐在湖边低头作画，身影被湖面衬成深色剪影。

en.title: The Island Church
en.description: Two people sit on a dock facing a lake island crowned by a church.

zh.title: 湖心岛
zh.description: 两人坐在栈桥边，望向湖心岛上从树梢间露出的教堂。

en.title: Meadow and Village
en.description: Yellow flowers fill the meadow below a village at the foot of the hills.

zh.title: 黄花田与村庄
zh.description: 黄花开在大片绿地上，村庄贴着远处的山脚。

en.title: Valley Road
en.description: Road signs line a valley road between green fields and wooded slopes.

zh.title: 山谷公路
zh.description: 公路从山谷的草地间穿过，路旁立着标志牌，后面是层层山坡。

en.title: Peaks and Pylons
en.description: Bare trees front the meadow, pylons and snow peaks lined up beyond.

zh.title: 雪峰与电线塔
zh.description: 几棵落叶树立在草坡前，远处电线塔和雪峰一字排开。

en.title: Blossoms Beside the Roofs
en.description: Pink blossom trees stand near the roofs, with a village and layered mountains beyond.

zh.title: 屋檐旁的花树
zh.description: 粉色花树在近处开着，村庄和层叠的山留在后面。

en.title: Castle on the Hill
en.description: A castle sits on a wooded hill, with houses and fields below.

zh.title: 山上的古堡
zh.description: 古堡立在林木覆盖的山顶，房屋与田野散在山脚。

en.title: Church Beneath the Clouds
en.description: Dark clouds hang above a spired church, with a bright starburst of light below.

zh.title: 云层压低的教堂
zh.description: 深色云层压在教堂上方，一盏灯在草地边亮成星形。

en.title: Rainbow Over the Field
en.description: A rainbow crosses the sky above a house, trees and green fields.

zh.title: 田边的彩虹
zh.description: 彩虹斜穿天空，下方是小屋、树木和绿地。

en.title: Rainbow over the Lake
en.description: A rainbow appears above the lake, with yellow-green trees along the far shore.

zh.title: 湖上的彩虹
zh.description: 湖面上方露出一道彩虹，对岸树林带着一层黄绿。

en.title: Crowd at the Fountain
en.description: Visitors line the rim beneath white figures and horses on the fountain's stone base.

zh.title: 喷泉与游客
zh.description: 白色人物和马匹雕塑铺开在石台上，游客沿喷泉边站成一排。

en.title: Palace Behind the Meadow
en.description: A long pale palace sits beyond a wildflower meadow, with the city lining the horizon.

zh.title: 草坡后的宫殿
zh.description: 大片草坡开着零星的黄花，浅色长宫殿横在远处，城市沿天边铺开。

en.title: Night Rails
en.description: Several tracks converge through a lit rail yard, signals glowing against the dark.

zh.title: 夜里的铁轨
zh.description: 多条铁轨在夜色里向前并线，站场灯光照亮道岔和信号灯。

en.title: Roofs Above the Sea
en.description: Red tiled roofs crowd the old town around a bell tower, the blue sea beyond.

zh.title: 俯瞰红屋顶
zh.description: 密密麻麻的红瓦屋顶铺满老城，钟楼立在中间，后面是蓝色的海。

en.title: Harbor Lights
en.description: Small boats rest in the dark harbor while the hillside houses glow with light.

zh.title: 夜港灯火
zh.description: 天黑后的港湾停着一排小船，山坡上的房子亮起成片灯火。

en.title: Waves Below the Walls
en.description: Waves break on the rocks below the walls of the old town on the cliffs.

zh.title: 城墙下的海
zh.description: 海浪拍打礁石，老城的石墙和海边房屋沿着崖边排开。

en.title: Valley Floor
en.description: Utility poles run down the green valley past scattered houses, grey mountains behind.

zh.title: 山脚下的路
zh.description: 电线杆沿着山谷排开，房屋散在绿树间，背后是一排灰色的山。

en.title: Mountain at the End of the Street
en.description: A pedestrian passes parked cars, with mountains rising behind the buildings.

zh.title: 山留在街尾
zh.description: 行人经过停满汽车的街道，远山立在楼房后面。

en.title: Sky in a Stone Circle
en.description: The open top of a stone rotunda frames a circle of blue sky.

zh.title: 石墙上的天空
zh.description: 石砌圆厅敞着顶，抬头就是一圈蓝天。

en.title: Red Roofs, Snowy Peaks
en.description: Old-town red roofs fill the foreground while a line of snowy peaks closes the horizon.

zh.title: 红屋顶与雪山
zh.description: 近处是老城的红瓦屋顶，远处一排雪山压在城市的天线上。

en.title: Steps Underground
en.description: Walkway steps wind down through the cave while warm lamps pick out the rock overhead.

zh.title: 洞里的台阶
zh.description: 溶洞里的栈道台阶蜿蜒向下，暖色灯光照亮头顶的岩石。

en.title: Island in the Mist
en.description: A white church with a red roof stands on the island, the shore and hills in mist.

zh.title: 雾里的湖心岛
zh.description: 湖心小岛上立着白墙红顶的教堂，两岸树林和远山罩在雾气里。

en.title: Trees Across the Lake
en.description: Dark green water meets a wooded shore with one small house, snow-dusted peaks beyond.

zh.title: 对岸的绿林
zh.description: 湖水绿得发暗，对岸树林里藏着一座小屋，更远处是残雪的山。

en.title: Small Tower in the Lake
en.description: A narrow little tower rises from the green lake with dense trees packed behind it.

zh.title: 水中的小亭
zh.description: 一座窄小的尖顶亭立在靠近岸边的湖水里，四周被绿树围住。

en.title: Castle Above the Lake
en.description: The castle perches on a rocky bluff above the lake, its orange roofs bright among trees.

zh.title: 崖顶古堡
zh.description: 古堡蹲在湖边的岩壁上，橙红色屋顶在绿树里很显眼。

en.title: Both Sides of the Lake
en.description: The castle holds the cliff at left while a church spire marks the far shore.

zh.title: 一湖两岸
zh.description: 城堡占着左边的岩壁，教堂尖顶立在右岸，背后是连绵的青山。

en.title: Boat Below the Castle
en.description: A rower brings a wooden boat past the castle cliff, trailing a line on green water.

zh.title: 湖上的木船
zh.description: 一人摇着木船从岩壁下经过，船尾在绿水上拖出一道水痕。

en.title: Mountains in Cloud
en.description: A castle rises above green woods, with the mountains partly hidden in cloud.

zh.title: 山在云里
zh.description: 城堡立在绿树上方，背后的山峰半藏在云里。

en.title: Overexposed Sea
en.description: Blown out to near white, the sea leaves only faint outlines of sails and one boat.

zh.title: 过曝的海
zh.description: 画面亮得几乎发白，几只帆板和一艘小船只剩淡淡的轮廓。

en.title: Four by the Sea
en.description: Four people face the sea from a pale colonnade.

zh.title: 海边的四个人
zh.description: 四个人站在海边的浅色柱廊里，望向同一片海。

en.title: Bubble Overhead
en.description: A clear bubble hangs above a raised hand against the night.

zh.title: 泡泡停在头顶
zh.description: 黑白夜景里，一颗透明泡泡悬在举起的手上方。

en.title: Backpacks Above the Sea
en.description: Backpackers rest on a low wall above the water, the shoreline town spread out below.

zh.title: 海边的背包
zh.description: 背着大包的人坐在海边的矮墙上，面前是岸边的房子和蓝绿色的海。

en.title: Palms Through the Window
en.description: The window cuts the view into a frame: a row of palms and a distant yellow car.

zh.title: 车窗里的棕榈
zh.description: 车窗像画框一样裁出外面的景色：一排棕榈树和远处一辆黄色小车。

en.title: Sea Past the Window
en.description: Through the window pass a promenade, one palm tree, a walker and the flat grey sea.

zh.title: 车窗外的海
zh.description: 透过车窗看见海边的步道和一棵棕榈，一个行人挨着栏杆走过。

en.title: Polka-Dot Stage
en.description: In the dark room big dots cover the stage wall and the audience stays in silhouette.

zh.title: 波点舞台
zh.description: 黑漆漆的演出厅里，舞台背景布满大圆点，观众只剩剪影。

en.title: Barcelona, from the Statue
en.description: A stone figure faces the city spread out toward the sea.

zh.title: 石像看巴塞罗那
zh.description: 前景石像背对镜头，城市一直铺到远处的海。

en.title: A Star on the Tower
en.description: Above the night-time city grid, an unfinished tower wears a lit star on top beside a crane.

zh.title: 塔顶的星
zh.description: 俯瞰城区夜景，未完工的高塔顶端亮着一颗星形灯，旁边立着塔吊。

en.title: Looking Up at Gold
en.description: Gold carving surrounds a bright opening high in the dome.

zh.title: 抬头看金色
zh.description: 金色雕饰围住穹顶，高处的开口透出亮光。

en.title: Walking the Cloister
en.description: Figures and a small child move through a vaulted cloister toward blinding light at the far arch.

zh.title: 回廊下的行人
zh.description: 拱廊尽头泄进强光，几个行人和一个矮小的孩子穿行其间。

en.title: Toward the Bright Arcade
en.description: A dark stone corridor ends in a sunlit arcade, its columns standing in full daylight.

zh.title: 深色拱廊
zh.description: 暗色拱廊的台阶尽头，列柱间涌进白昼的光。

en.title: Red Bus, Cliff Road
en.description: A red bus follows the narrow road below a rocky hillside.

zh.title: 红巴士过山路
zh.description: 红色巴士经过岩壁下的窄路，楼房散在上方的山坡。

en.title: Two Figures on the Hill
en.description: Umbrella pines shade a grassy slope where two tiny figures stand on the hilltop.

zh.title: 坡顶的两个人
zh.description: 草坡上松树成荫，坡顶站着两个细小的人影。

en.title: Forest of Stone Columns
en.description: Branching stone columns hold up the vault, colored light spilling across them from stained glass.

zh.title: 彩光里的石柱林
zh.description: 分叉的石柱撑起高顶，彩窗把颜色投在柱身和顶棚上。

en.title: A Tangle of Wings
en.description: Gulls crowd the water, their outstretched wings overlapping.

zh.title: 翅膀挤在一起
zh.description: 海鸥贴着水面聚在一起，展开的翅膀互相交错。

en.title: The Kissing Wall
en.description: A couple kisses in front of a red mosaic wall made of many small tiles.

zh.title: 红墙前的吻
zh.description: 两人站在红色马赛克拼墙前接吻，墙面由细密的小块瓷砖组成。

en.title: Large Face, Small Screens
en.description: People check phones and take photographs beside a giant baby-head sculpture.

zh.title: 大脸与小屏幕
zh.description: 巨大的婴儿头像前，人们低头看手机或举起手机拍照。

en.title: Snow on the Jetty
en.description: A snow-covered jetty reaches out across the frozen water.

zh.title: 雪压住了栈桥
zh.description: 积雪沿着狭长的栈桥伸向冰面。

en.title: A Dot on the Frozen Bay
en.description: A single distant figure stands on the frozen sea while a plume of smoke rises at the horizon.

zh.title: 冰原远处的人
zh.description: 白茫茫的冰封海面上只有一个远处的人影，地平线上腾起一缕烟。

en.title: Five Walkers on Ice
en.description: Five people spread across the ice, with curved tracks behind them.

zh.title: 五个人走上冰面
zh.description: 五个人分散在冰面上，几道弯曲的脚印留在身后。

en.title: Orange on the Bridge
en.description: An orange figure crosses the bridge in front of dark trees.

zh.title: 桥上的一点橙色
zh.description: 深色树林前，一个橙色身影走过桥面。

en.title: A Small Shape on the Ice
en.description: Someone crouches on the pale ice, with tracks curving across the foreground.

zh.title: 冰面上的小黑点
zh.description: 淡色冰面上蹲着一个人，脚印从近处绕向远方。

en.title: Tree Lights in the Snow
en.description: A tree wrapped in string lights glows in a snowy yard beside a small building's lit doorway.

zh.title: 雪夜亮灯的树
zh.description: 积雪的小院里立着一棵缀满灯串的树，一旁小屋门口还亮着灯。

en.title: At the Winter Stall
en.description: Neon signs light the night as adults and a small hatted child pause at the stall.

zh.title: 夜市摊前
zh.description: 霓虹招牌照亮了摊位，几个大人的背影前站着一个戴浅色帽子的小孩。

en.title: Carousel in the Square
en.description: A crowd gathers around a bright carousel in front of a pale building.

zh.title: 广场上的旋转木马
zh.description: 明亮的旋转木马前围着人群，浅色建筑留在背后。

en.title: Children on the Carousel
en.description: Among strands of warm bulbs, children in heavy coats ride past on painted horses.

zh.title: 木马上的孩子们
zh.description: 暖黄的灯串之间，裹着厚外套的孩子们骑在木马背上经过。

en.title: Painted Horses, Close Up
en.description: Bridles and carved saddles of the carousel horses fill the frame, lamps dissolving behind.

zh.title: 彩绘木马
zh.description: 木马的缰绳和雕饰塞满画面，背景的圆灯虚成了光斑。

en.title: Cathedral in Blue
en.description: Blue-violet light covers the colonnade and the crowded steps.

zh.title: 大教堂亮成蓝色
zh.description: 蓝紫灯光铺过柱廊和台阶，夜色里站满人。

en.title: Statue Over the Light Field
en.description: The dark figure on its pedestal faces a square scattered with clusters of glowing light sculptures.

zh.title: 灯丛中的雕像
zh.description: 基座上的人像背对镜头，脚下的广场散布着成丛的发光装置。

en.title: Three on the Snow Slope
en.description: Three silhouettes stand below a blue-lit snow slope and round lights.

zh.title: 雪坡上的三个人
zh.description: 三个人影站在泛蓝的雪坡前，圆形灯光悬在上方。

en.title: Relief, Looking Up
en.description: Figures in relief emerge from shadow in this monochrome frame.

zh.title: 仰看浮雕
zh.description: 黑白画面里，人物浮雕的轮廓从暗处凸出来。

en.title: Backlit Yellow Leaves
en.description: Sunlight pours through the canopy, and the frame is filled almost entirely with glowing yellow leaves.

zh.title: 透光黄叶
zh.description: 阳光从树冠背后照进来，画面几乎被透亮的黄叶占满。

en.title: Red Ivy on the Corner
en.description: Red ivy covers the corner of a tall building, with yellow traffic signs standing against a deep blue sky.

zh.title: 红藤爬上转角
zh.description: 一栋转角高楼的墙面爬满变红的藤蔓，楼下立着几块黄色交通标志。

en.title: The Yellow Tree in the Park
en.description: A path runs through a leaf-strewn park toward one very yellow tree, with walkers small in the distance.

zh.title: 公园里那棵黄树
zh.description: 小径穿过落满叶子的公园，中间一棵大树黄得很显眼，远处有行人走过。

en.title: Shadows Across the Bend
en.description: Tree shadows stretch long across a curving road scattered with yellow leaves between green banks.

zh.title: 弯道上的树影
zh.description: 林荫下的弯道落着黄叶，低角度的树影横拉在路面上。

en.title: Red Moon Above the Roofs
en.description: A red moon hangs in a deep blue sky above the city.

zh.title: 楼顶上方一轮红月
zh.description: 红色月亮悬在深蓝天空里，下方是密集楼群。

en.title: Sitting on the Pier Edge
en.description: Most of the frame sits in deep shadow; only the pier edge is lit, where one person sits.

zh.title: 码头边坐着的人
zh.description: 大半画面浸在阴影里，只有水边码头被照亮，一人坐在岸沿。

en.title: Figure at the Tunnel's End
en.description: The arched tunnel is nearly black, and a figure stands in the warm light at its far end.

zh.title: 隧道尽头的人
zh.description: 拱形隧道里几乎全黑，尽头亮着暖光，一个人站在出口处。

en.title: Trees and Open Ground
en.description: Beyond a wide bare field stand trees and grass-topped mounds, with a few walkers far off.

zh.title: 树下空地
zh.description: 开阔的空场边立着几棵树，树后露出草顶的土坡，远处有人走过。

en.title: Bright Door in a Stone Wall
en.description: A dark stone wall is cut by one bright doorway where a person stands, grass sloping in front.

zh.title: 石门里的亮口
zh.description: 深色石墙中间开着一个门洞，内外明暗反差很大，一人站在亮处。

en.title: A Pause on the Rocks
en.description: Someone sits on the coastal rocks, facing the distant city skyline.

zh.title: 礁石上的停留
zh.description: 海边礁石上有人坐着，对岸是一线城市轮廓。

en.title: Two Figures on the Grass
en.description: Two people stand side by side on a grassy bank, looking down toward the long pink building.

zh.title: 坡上的两个人
zh.description: 草坡上一红一白两个人并肩站着，望向坡下那栋粉色的长楼。

en.title: Sitting Alone by the Water
en.description: One person sits with their back turned on waterside rocks; more figures walk the grassy rise behind.

zh.title: 水边独坐
zh.description: 一人背对镜头坐在水边礁石上，远处草坡上还有几个人在走。

en.title: Grass-Roofed Fortifications
en.description: Grass covers old earthworks and bunkers, dirt paths crossing between them, the sea faint behind.

zh.title: 草顶工事
zh.description: 土坡和掩体上长满草，小径在其间穿过，远处能看见海。

en.title: One Small Sail
en.description: A small white sail sits near the pale horizon of a broad sea.

zh.title: 海上留一小片帆
zh.description: 大片海面上，一片白帆靠近淡色的地平线。

en.title: Grass Slope by the Wall
en.description: A steep grass bank climbs beside a tall stone fortification, a narrow path threading its base.

zh.title: 石墙边的草坡
zh.description: 高大的石砌工事旁是陡直的草坡，一条窄路贴着坡面往上。

en.title: Above the Square
en.description: Someone sits above a square of yellow facades and a central statue.

zh.title: 坐在广场上方
zh.description: 一个人坐在高处台阶边，脚下是雕像与黄色楼房围着的广场。

en.title: Tram at the Corner
en.description: A tram crosses the cobbled intersection beneath a web of wires.

zh.title: 电车转过街角
zh.description: 电车经过石板路口，上方是交错的电线。

en.title: At the End of the Pier
en.description: In near-darkness, two figures stand at the far end of a wooden pier over still water.

zh.title: 栈桥尽头
zh.description: 天色已经暗透，两个人站在伸向水面的栈桥尽头，四下只有水。

en.title: A Path Through Shadow
en.description: A narrow passage holds a strip of light on the grass.

zh.title: 暗处的一条亮路
zh.description: 狭长通道里，一条亮光落在草地上。

en.title: The Little Red Car in Snow
en.description: A small red car sits by birches at a snowy junction, the road thinly blanketed in white.

zh.title: 雪天里的小红车
zh.description: 雪后的街口，一辆红色小车停在白桦树边，路上积着薄雪。

en.title: Walking into Falling Snow
en.description: In heavy falling snow a person in a dark coat walks away down the road, shoulders already white.

zh.title: 落雪里独行
zh.description: 雪正下得密，行人裹紧深色大衣沿公路往前走，肩上已经白了一层。

en.title: Warning Sign in the Snow
en.description: A yellow triangular warning sign stands beside the snowbound road, the trees along it loaded with snow.

zh.title: 雪中警示牌
zh.description: 积雪的路旁立着一块黄色三角警示牌，路边的树都挂满了雪。

en.title: Crossing a Snowy Junction
en.description: Pedestrians cross a snowy junction between a glass building on one side and red brick on the other.

zh.title: 雪中的路口
zh.description: 细雪中的路口，行人正横穿马路，一侧是玻璃楼，一侧是红砖房。

en.title: Snowy Sidewalk at Night
en.description: Streetlamps line a snow-covered sidewalk beside a long brick building with orange roadwork signs.

zh.title: 雪夜人行道
zh.description: 路灯沿积雪的人行道排开，橙色路牌立在红砖楼旁。

en.title: Street Sign in Snow
en.description: A bilingual street sign stands at a snowy junction, buildings fading beyond it.

zh.title: 路牌留在雪里
zh.description: 双语路牌立在积雪路口，楼房在白茫茫的远处淡去。

en.title: Green Signal, Piled Snow
en.description: A green light glows above snow piled along the road while a glass building fades into fog.

zh.title: 绿灯与雪堆
zh.description: 雪堆快没到杆底，绿灯亮着，玻璃楼在雾里只剩轮廓。

en.title: Snow Beside the Brick Building
en.description: Windows glow in the brick building beside figures on the snow-covered road.

zh.title: 砖楼边的雪
zh.description: 砖楼的窗还亮着，几个人影走在白茫茫的路上。

en.title: A Slant of Light
en.description: A pale shaft of light cuts diagonally through the dark frame.

zh.title: 一束斜光
zh.description: 暗色画面里，一束浅色的光斜着穿过。

en.title: Two Round Portraits
en.description: Two round portrait medallions hang on a stone wall while half of a visitor's face enters the frame.

zh.title: 墙上两枚头像
zh.description: 两枚圆形肖像嵌在石墙上，画框边露出一位参观者低着的半张脸。

en.title: Figures Through the Arch
en.description: Silhouetted walkers move through a dark masonry archway toward a patch of warm light.

zh.title: 走向光的人群
zh.description: 拱廊深处透出一团暖光，几个人的剪影正朝亮处走。

en.title: Tree on the Riverbank
en.description: A single yellowing tree stands on the green riverbank with faint traffic on the far shore.

zh.title: 河岸一棵树
zh.description: 阴天里，一棵泛黄的小树立在河岸草地上，对岸隐约有车辆。

en.title: Stone Wall, Grey Street
en.description: A monument's dark mass fills the left of this monochrome frame while a lone walker recedes down the street.

zh.title: 石墙与灰街
zh.description: 黑白画面里，石碑的阴影占住左侧，右侧小路上有个走远的人影。

en.title: Suitcase at Corridor's End
en.description: A person with a rolling suitcase stands at the lit end of a long green corridor.

zh.title: 走廊尽头的人
zh.description: 绿色走廊灯管通明，一个拖行李箱的人停在尽头的亮光里。

en.title: Warm Door, Blue Stairs
en.description: Someone passes a warm-lit doorway beside blue concrete stairs.

zh.title: 蓝色楼梯旁的门
zh.description: 蓝色楼梯旁的门洞透出暖光，一个人从亮处经过。

en.title: City Lights From Above
en.description: An elevated night view shows a lit spire rising over dense rooftops and bands of streetlight.

zh.title: 俯瞰夜景
zh.description: 从高处望下，尖塔和成片的屋顶亮起灯，光带延向远处。

en.title: Lamplight in the Alley
en.description: A single old streetlamp lights cobblestones between stone columns, a small dark shape resting near the wall.

zh.title: 夜巷孤灯
zh.description: 一盏旧路灯照亮石柱间的石板路，墙角边蜷着一团小黑影。

en.title: Tatooine Sunset
en.description: From the hotel window an iron bridge and spire sink into an orange sunset the photo only hints at.

zh.title: 塔图因日落
zh.description: 酒店窗外，铁桥与尖塔沉在橙色落日里，肉眼所见远强于照片。

en.title: Breakfast Room With a View
en.description: Potted plants line a breakfast room window while a church spire shows faintly through the haze outside.

zh.title: 窗边的早餐室
zh.description: 早餐室的桌边摆着盆栽，隔着玻璃能看见雾里浮出一座尖塔。

en.title: Red and White Above the Trees
en.description: A slender red-and-white tower rises behind the treetops.

zh.title: 树梢后的一条红白线
zh.description: 红白相间的细塔从树梢后方升起。

en.title: Under the Graffiti Wall
en.description: A pedestrian passes a brick gable and wall covered edge to edge in graffiti.

zh.title: 涂鸦墙下
zh.description: 整面砖墙和山墙涂满涂鸦，一个行人正从墙根走过。

en.title: White Ring on the Rail
en.description: A white life ring hangs against sunlit orange-red panelling.

zh.title: 船边的白色圆环
zh.description: 白色救生圈挂在栏杆上，橘红色船体照进一束光。

en.title: Rooftops Below the Snowpeak
en.description: A visitor leans on a railing above tiled roofs with snow peaks rising beyond the trees.

zh.title: 雪山下的屋顶
zh.description: 一个人倚着栏杆，眼前是瓦屋顶和树，再远处雪山浮在云上。

en.title: Ridges in the Clouds
en.description: Blue ridges recede in layers while a snow-covered summit breaks through the cloud line.

zh.title: 云上的山脊
zh.description: 青色山脊一层层向远处退去，积雪的峰顶从云缝里露出。

en.title: Looking Down the Gorge
en.description: From a high viewpoint the river narrows to a thread between steep scree slopes.

zh.title: 俯瞰深谷
zh.description: 从高处俯看，河谷夹在碎石坡之间，谷底的水细成一条线。

en.title: Bridge Below the Snowpeak
en.description: A small bridge crosses the water below a sunlit snowpeak.

zh.title: 小桥与雪峰
zh.description: 小桥跨过水面，背后的雪峰被阳光照亮。

en.title: A Photograph Below the Peak
en.description: Two people stand on a wooden walkway below clouds and snowy mountains.

zh.title: 雪山前合个影
zh.description: 两个人站在木栈道上，背后是云与雪山。

en.title: Mountains Upside Down
en.description: Someone sits beside green water reflecting mountains and clouds.

zh.title: 湖水把山倒过来
zh.description: 一个人坐在绿色湖水旁，山与云倒映在水面。

en.title: CITY LIFE SUCKS
en.description: Musicians play in a small venue below a disco ball and this sign.

zh.title: CITY LIFE SUCKS
zh.description: 小小的演出空间里，乐手站在镜面球和这块招牌下。

en.title: Chalk Portrait at Night
en.description: At night a person crouches over a chalk portrait on the pavement, two handwritten Chinese characters beside it.

zh.title: 地上画脸的人
zh.description: 夜里一人蹲在路边画粉笔肖像，旁边地上还写着哑巴两个字。

en.title: Lakeside Gravel Path
en.description: A gravel path follows the wooded shoreline toward low hills across the bay.

zh.title: 湖边碎石小径
zh.description: 碎石小路沿湖岸延伸，树冠遮住画面上缘，远处是低矮的湖湾和山。

en.title: Palace Roofs in Haze
en.description: From above, rows of yellow glazed roofs stretch into the haze over a crowd filling the gate square.

zh.title: 雾中紫禁城
zh.description: 从高处俯瞰，黄色琉璃瓦屋顶连绵铺开，将两扇大门之间广场挤满游客。

en.title: Straight Avenue Through Hutongs
en.description: A straight tree-lined street runs between grey-tiled hutong roofs toward a distant hill.

zh.title: 胡同间的直街
zh.description: 树荫夹道的长街笔直伸向远处的山丘，两旁是灰瓦屋顶的平房院。

en.title: Terraced Garden Beds
en.description: Terraced stone planting beds climb the slope toward tall willows at the top.

zh.title: 石阶花坛
zh.description: 层层石砌花坛沿坡往上排，尽头立着高大的垂柳和浓密的绿树。

en.title: Rows of Trees on Grass
en.description: Two rows of tall trees stand on the lawn, a straight shaded corridor between them.

zh.title: 草地树列
zh.description: 两排高树立在草地上，中间留出一条浓荫覆着的笔直通道。

en.title: Moon Over the Dome
en.description: A curved glass dome edges into frame beneath a black sky holding one small moon.

zh.title: 巨蛋与月
zh.description: 弧形穹顶从画面底部探出一道边线，头顶漆黑的夜空里挂着一点月亮。

en.title: Hall of Prayer in Sun
en.description: Three tiers of blue tiled roofs narrow upward under clear sky, ringed by white marble balustrades.

zh.title: 祈年殿
zh.description: 三层蓝瓦攒尖顶在晴天里层层收窄，白色石栏杆沿台基绕殿一周。

en.title: Skyline Beyond Red Wall
en.description: Beyond a red wall and treetops, the glass towers of the business district rise into blue sky.

zh.title: 红墙外的天际线
zh.description: 红墙与绿树之外，远处玻璃高楼群顶着蓝天，最高一栋轮廓是中国尊。

en.title: Rows of Red
en.description: Rows of red seats curve toward the stage beneath a sweeping ceiling.

zh.title: 红色座椅的弧线
zh.description: 一圈圈红色座椅朝向舞台，顶棚沿着同样的弧线展开。

en.title: White Caps Crossing
en.description: People in white caps cross the street backlit by harsh sun between glass buildings.

zh.title: 白帽过街
zh.description: 戴白帽的人群逆着光穿过街口，身后玻璃楼群之间透出刺眼的太阳。

en.title: Sitting by the Fountain
en.description: A bronze figure tops the fountain column while someone sits on the basin edge, pale apartment blocks behind.

zh.title: 喷泉边坐着的人
zh.description: 铜像立在喷泉水池中央的立柱上，一人抱臂坐在池沿，背后是浅色多层楼。

en.title: Shoreline Upside Down
en.description: Colourful figures reflect in the water beside stones and reeds.

zh.title: 倒过来的岸边
zh.description: 水面映着岸边的彩色人影，石头和芦苇沿着画面边缘排开。

en.title: Toward San Giorgio
en.description: A gondola and a white motorboat rest on blue water facing San Giorgio Maggiore's church and campanile.

zh.title: 圣乔治岛方向
zh.description: 蓝水上泊着贡多拉和白色快艇，对岸是圣乔治马焦雷教堂与高高的钟楼。

en.title: Venice, Roof After Roof
en.description: Beyond a dome, terracotta roofs stretch toward the lagoon.

zh.title: 威尼斯的屋顶们
zh.description: 一座圆顶之后，红瓦屋顶一直铺向远处的泻湖。

en.title: Boats on the Grand Canal
en.description: A vaporetto and gondolas move between old palazzi, mooring posts lined along the canal edge.

zh.title: 大运河船流
zh.description: 水上巴士和贡多拉在两侧老楼之间穿行，木桩沿岸一排排插在水里。

en.title: Under the Rialto Arch
en.description: A gondolier poles beneath the Rialto arch while people lean along the balustrade above.

zh.title: 里亚托桥洞
zh.description: 船工撑长篙把贡多拉划过里亚托桥的拱洞，桥栏边站满了往下看的人。

en.title: Sun Setting on the Canal
en.description: The sun sinks behind rooflines, spreading gold across the water and leaving boats as silhouettes.

zh.title: 运河落日
zh.description: 太阳贴着屋檐往下沉，水面铺满金色反光，小船和建筑都只剩剪影。

en.title: Teal Hour for Gondolas
en.description: Under a deep teal sky a gondolier rows past mooring posts, the campanile faint across the lagoon.

zh.title: 青蓝色水面
zh.description: 天光转成青蓝色，船夫摇着贡多拉经过木桩，远处钟楼只剩一道淡影。

en.title: Lamps Along the Quay
en.description: Ornate lamps come on along the stone quay where people sit at the edge facing the water.

zh.title: 岸边路灯
zh.description: 复古多头路灯在石板岸边次第亮起，几个人坐在堤沿上对着水面。

en.title: Sitting by the Water
en.description: Two people sit facing gondolas and a distant dome across the water.

zh.title: 坐着等天黑
zh.description: 两个人背对镜头坐在岸边，贡多拉和远处的圆顶留在水面另一边。

en.title: The Dock in Blue
en.description: People gather on a wooden dock beside lamplight and deep blue water.

zh.title: 蓝色时刻的码头
zh.description: 灯柱旁的木码头上站着几个人，深蓝水面通向远处钟楼。

en.title: Night on the Promenade
en.description: Lamplight falls on one corner of the promenade where people sit, far shore lights strung in a line.

zh.title: 堤岸夜色
zh.description: 路灯照亮堤岸一角，几个人坐在石沿上，对岸的灯连成细细一条线。

en.title: Gondola Stand After Dark
en.description: Lamps glow over the blue gondola-service stand while boatmen wait on the quay.

zh.title: 夜里的贡多拉站
zh.description: 蓝色招牌下路灯亮着，几名船夫站在岸边候客。

en.title: Signs in the Alley
en.description: Pizzeria signs crowd the stone walls while daylight filters down to passersby below.

zh.title: 窄巷招牌
zh.description: 披萨店等小招牌挤满石墙，巷底透出亮光和人影。

en.title: A Stone Doorway
en.description: Pedestrians pass the dark stone portal while a man checks his phone by the gate.

zh.title: 石门入口
zh.description: 深色石楼门前人来人往，右侧一男子倚墙看手机。

en.title: An Umbrella for the Statue
en.description: Visitors rest below a bronze statue backed by an umbrella pine.

zh.title: 伞松替铜像打伞
zh.description: 铜像前坐着几位游客，身后的伞松撑开树冠。

en.title: Arch Framing a Monument
en.description: From inside a dark archway, a bright sculpted monument closes the view down the street.

zh.title: 暗拱门看街
zh.description: 从暗拱门内望去，饰浮雕的亮白建筑立在街道尽头。

en.title: Parade Figures Under Flags
en.description: Pennant strings cross the street where giant festival figures rise over the crowd and murals.

zh.title: 彩旗下的人偶
zh.description: 彩旗串挂满街口，巨型人偶高过人群，墙上是巨幅人像画。

en.title: Sea Through the Grille
en.description: Behind a wire grille the bay stretches wide, with a castle on the shore and a seated viewer.

zh.title: 网格外海景
zh.description: 铁丝网格后海面平阔，岸边城堡贴着水线，有人坐着看海。

en.title: A Figure in the Opening
en.description: A figure sits in the bright opening of a dark arch, overlooking the city.

zh.title: 窗里留一个人
zh.description: 黑色拱洞里，一个人影靠着亮处，远方是城市。

en.title: Bay Under the Volcano
en.description: Ships and harbor fill the bay while the volcano holds only a faint outline in the haze.

zh.title: 雾中维苏威
zh.description: 海湾铺满货船与码头，雾后火山只剩一道淡灰轮廓。

en.title: An Empty Courtyard
en.description: Brick pavement climbs between white walls toward one small figure at the far end.

zh.title: 空庭远人
zh.description: 白墙之间的砖石坡庭空荡，尽头立着一个身影。

en.title: Naples, All the Way Out
en.description: Trees border the terrace above rooftops stretching to the horizon.

zh.title: 那不勒斯铺到远处
zh.description: 近处是高台和树冠，远处的屋顶一直连到天边。

en.title: Hands Up in the Courtyard
en.description: Someone raises both hands in a wide courtyard enclosed by white walls.

zh.title: 空院子里举个手
zh.description: 一个人背对镜头举起双手，白墙围着宽阔的院子。

en.title: Escalator of Small Lights
en.description: Escalators descend into the metro station between dense ribbons of small white lights.

zh.title: 扶梯灯点
zh.description: 地铁扶梯向深处延伸，两侧灯点密集成带排下去。

en.title: Green Beside the Escalator
en.description: A person in green stands beside the escalator among glass and steel.

zh.title: 扶梯旁的绿衣人
zh.description: 玻璃与钢架之间，绿衣人站在扶梯旁。

en.title: The Window Seat
en.description: A passenger sits beside the window, with tracks and walls outside.

zh.title: 靠窗的座位
zh.description: 乘客坐在车窗边，外面是经过的轨道与墙面。

en.title: City Below the Green Slope
en.description: The foreground slope drops away to a gray-blue sprawl of the city held in thin haze.

zh.title: 草坡下的城
zh.description: 草坡从前景斜下去，远处城区在薄霭里摊成灰蓝一片。

en.title: A Bend in the Hill Road
en.description: A pale road bends twice down the green hill with the city spread along the hazy foot of the slope.

zh.title: 山道转弯处
zh.description: 浅色山道在绿坡上拐了两个弯，城市贴着山根铺开。

en.title: Pointing Toward the Haze
en.description: A backpacked visitor on the summit points toward the coastline dissolving in haze.

zh.title: 塔塔开
zh.description: 背背包的人站在山顶，伸臂指向雾里淡出的海岸与城。

en.title: Glass Shelter, Waiting Riders
en.description: People wait inside and around the glass shelter while the reversed station name runs along the beam.

zh.title: 玻璃候车亭
zh.description: 玻璃候车亭内外站着等车人，站名字样在顶梁上反着。

en.title: Stone Street Between Ruins
en.description: Flagstones run downhill between ruined walls toward a distant arch and mountains.

zh.title: 石巷残墙
zh.description: 石板路在残墙之间下坡延伸，尽头立着远山和一座拱门。

en.title: A Path Through Old Walls
en.description: A stone path threads between high ruined walls with a few visitors scattered along both sides.

zh.title: 石径游人
zh.description: 高起的残墙夹出石径，两侧墙下散着几名参观的人。

en.title: Arches and a Stone Pine
en.description: A row of stone arches lines the grounds while one umbrella pine rises above the walls under clear sky.

zh.title: 石拱与伞松
zh.description: 连排石拱沿场地排开，一棵伞松高出墙头立在晴空下。

en.title: Mountain Behind the Ruins
en.description: A mountain rises behind old walls and green trees.

zh.title: 废墟后面的山
zh.description: 残墙与绿树后方，一座山峰从浅色天空中显出来。

en.title: Waiting on the Platform
en.description: Passengers sit at the platform edge beside tracks and white columns.

zh.title: 站台边等一等
zh.description: 几位乘客坐在站台边，铁轨沿着白色柱廊经过。

en.title: Waiting Between Red Walls
en.description: Passengers wait between red walls and railings, with sunlight through the arch.

zh.title: 红墙里的候车处
zh.description: 乘客在红墙与栏杆之间等候，阳光从拱门照进来。

en.title: Into the Metro
en.description: Someone walks along the train on a narrow underground platform.

zh.title: 走进地铁深处
zh.description: 狭长地下站台上，一个人沿着列车向前走。

en.title: Baptistery, Dome, and Bell Tower
en.description: From the square below, the baptistery, bell tower, and brick dome rise together into a clear sky.

zh.title: 洗礼堂与穹顶并肩
zh.description: 仰拍视角里，八角洗礼堂、高耸钟楼与红砖穹顶在蓝天下排成一列。

en.title: Passing the Carousel
en.description: People pass a carousel in the square beside a tall stone column.

zh.title: 旋转木马旁边过
zh.description: 人们从广场的旋转木马旁经过，石柱立在画面中间。

en.title: Three Figures in One Spiral
en.description: Three marble figures twist upward in a single spiral, a small bronze warrior guarding the base.

zh.title: 纠缠上升的三人
zh.description: 三个人物在同一组螺旋中纠缠着向上攀升，左下角还有一尊持武器的小铜像。

en.title: Bronze Holding a Head Aloft
en.description: The bronze figure raises a severed head on high, thrown into silhouette against the warm stone wall.

zh.title: 举着头颅的铜像
zh.description: 铜像手上高举着一颗头颅，身形在暖黄色石墙前压成深色剪影。

en.title: A Struggle in Marble
en.description: Two marble figures grapple, their shadows falling on the wall behind.

zh.title: 石像也在较劲
zh.description: 一高一低的两个石雕人物靠在一起，身后留着深色影子。

en.title: A Gothic Spire, Hazy Hills
en.description: Under flat grey light the church's tall gable and spire rise above the rooftops, hills fading behind.

zh.title: 尖顶教堂与远山
zh.description: 阴天里教堂的尖顶与山墙高过屋顶线，背后的远山只剩一层灰色。

en.title: The Great Dome Above the Roofs
en.description: From a raised overlook the cathedral dome and bell tower clear the rooftops against pale ridges.

zh.title: 屋顶线上的大穹顶
zh.description: 从高处观景台俯瞰，大教堂穹顶与钟楼越过屋顶线，山脊在背后发灰。

en.title: One Dome Among the Roofs
en.description: A green dome rises among dense rooftops with hills beyond.

zh.title: 一片屋顶一个穹顶
zh.description: 密集屋顶之间露出绿色穹顶，远山在后面铺开。

en.title: Terrace Above the River
en.description: Visitors sit beneath terrace umbrellas above the river and city.

zh.title: 高处的露台
zh.description: 露台的遮阳伞下坐着人，河流与城市铺在下方。

en.title: A Seat Above Florence
en.description: People pause on stone steps overlooking the city and its great dome.

zh.title: 在高处坐一会儿
zh.description: 几个人停在高处的石台阶上，远处的大穹顶高过屋顶。

en.title: Drawing at the Parapet
en.description: A woman with pinned-up hair leans over the parapet, drawing the rooftops spread out below her.

zh.title: 伏栏速写的人
zh.description: 盘发女子背对镜头伏在石栏上动笔，面前铺开整片老城的屋顶。

en.title: Arms and Phones Aloft
en.description: In black and white the crowd turns away from the camera, dozens of phones lifted toward the same point.

zh.title: 一同举起的手机
zh.description: 黑白画面里人群背对镜头，几十部手机齐齐举过头顶对准同一个方向。

en.title: The Railing After Dark
en.description: After dark the crowd still packs the railing while lights string together along the foot of the hills.

zh.title: 亮灯后的看台
zh.description: 天黑之后人群仍靠着栏杆挤成一排，城区的灯沿山脚连成一片。

en.title: Lamplight and the Distant City
en.description: A nearby lamp glows before a line of illuminated buildings in the distance.

zh.title: 路灯与远处的城
zh.description: 近处路灯亮成一团，远处建筑的灯光沿着夜色排开。

en.title: Still Here After Dark
en.description: People linger on the terrace as city lights reflect in the river below.

zh.title: 天黑了还没走
zh.description: 人们留在观景台上，城市的灯映在远处河面。

en.title: Floodlit Brick Tower
en.description: Against a deep blue sky the brick tower is floodlit warm orange while the people below turn to silhouettes.

zh.title: 暖光点亮的砖塔
zh.description: 天光还剩一层深蓝，砖塔被暖色灯光从下往上打亮，塔下人群只剩剪影。

en.title: A Plane Past the Tower
en.description: From the tower's base the white arcades tilt through the frame as a small plane crosses the clear sky.

zh.title: 斜塔前的飞机
zh.description: 贴着塔基仰拍，斜塔的白色拱廊占去半个画面，一架小飞机正横过晴空。

en.title: Tower Beside the Cathedral
en.description: The Leaning Tower rises beside the cathedral, with visitors gathered below.

zh.title: 斜塔旁的石墙
zh.description: 斜塔从大教堂旁露出来，游客聚在白色建筑下面。

en.title: Statues Against Red Walls
en.description: Statues line the passage through a red-walled gallery beside tall windows.

zh.title: 红墙里的雕像
zh.description: 高窗旁的红墙展厅里，雕像沿着过道排列。

en.title: A Sunbeam Finds the Marbles
en.description: A slanting beam crosses the floor and lands on the marble group at center, the side statues left in shadow.

zh.title: 斜光照亮群雕
zh.description: 一道斜光扫过地面落在展厅中央的白色群雕上，两侧的立像留在暗处。

en.title: Horseman Before the Bright Door
en.description: An equestrian bronze stands in shadow before a bright doorway.

zh.title: 亮门前的骑马像
zh.description: 骑马铜像留在暗处，背后的门洞透进白光。

en.title: The Empty Vaulted Gallery
en.description: The barrel-vaulted gallery hangs its paintings on white walls above a wooden floor that mirrors the ceiling lights.

zh.title: 空荡的拱顶长廊
zh.description: 筒形拱顶的长廊空无一人，油画挂在白墙两侧，木地板上映出顶灯。

en.title: Spiral Down
en.description: The double spiral staircase winds downward, with visitors descending the stepped ramps.

zh.title: 旋梯向下
zh.description: 俯拍的双旋梯层层向下，游客正沿坡道走下。

en.title: Up the Stairwell
en.description: Seen from the stairwell's base, the spiral ends at a round skylight glowing blue.

zh.title: 井底望天
zh.description: 从井底仰望，旋梯尽头是一扇透着蓝光的玻璃天窗。

en.title: Night Terrace
en.description: Under tall pines at night, a group gathers on a terrace beside blue lamplight.

zh.title: 夜游松台
zh.description: 夜晚的高松下，露台上一群人围站在蓝色灯影旁。

en.title: Night Crowd
en.description: At night the square fills with a seated crowd, rows of red chairs facing the lit buildings.

zh.title: 夜里的人群
zh.description: 夜色里广场坐满人群，成片红色座椅朝向亮灯的建筑。

en.title: Water Beyond the Window
en.description: Silhouettes stand at a dark window framing rocks and water outside.

zh.title: 窗外的水声
zh.description: 暗室的窗格框住外面的石头与水，窗前站着人影。

en.title: Pine Beside the Ruins
en.description: A path passes broken brick walls and a pine beside the grass.

zh.title: 残墙边的伞松
zh.description: 土路绕过砖石残墙，伞松立在草地边。

en.title: Forum from Above
en.description: From above, a triumphal arch, ruined walls, a bell tower and domes share one crowded view.

zh.title: 俯瞰古墟
zh.description: 高处俯瞰，凯旋门、残墙与后方的钟楼和圆顶挤在同一视野。

en.title: Among the Broken Columns
en.description: Broken columns and foundations scatter across the grass while visitors thread the paths between them.

zh.title: 残柱之间
zh.description: 断柱与地基散布在草地上，游客沿小路穿行其间。

en.title: Square from the Dome
en.description: From the basilica's dome, the obelisk stands centered in the elliptical colonnaded square.

zh.title: 穹顶看广场
zh.description: 从教堂穹顶俯瞰，方尖碑立在椭圆形柱廊广场的中央。

en.title: Figures in Relief
en.description: Raking light crosses a stone relief, lifting tangled figures out of the darkness.

zh.title: 石面群像
zh.description: 侧面光线扫过石质浮雕，纠缠的人像浮出暗底。

en.title: Statues Below the Gold
en.description: Side light falls on a dark statue surrounded by pale sculpted figures.

zh.title: 金顶下的雕像
zh.description: 光从侧面照进来，深色雕像与浅色人物雕刻围在一起。

en.title: Gold at the Far End
en.description: Gold ornament surrounds a bright centre at the far end of the dark interior.

zh.title: 大殿尽头的金色
zh.description: 暗色大殿的尽头，金色装饰围着一团亮光。

en.title: Seated Stone Figures
en.description: On the honey-colored marble monument, allegorical figures sit and stand in niches.

zh.title: 石座上的群像
zh.description: 蜜色大理石纪念碑上，几尊寓意人物或坐或立。

en.title: Dove in the Golden Glow
en.description: Golden rays encircle the dove window above the altar, an angel figure to one side.

zh.title: 金辉鸽窗
zh.description: 金色光芒环绕着祭坛上方的鸽形圆窗，一旁立着天使。

en.title: Guards at the Gate
en.description: Two guards in striped red, yellow and blue uniforms stand by the arch and sentry box.

zh.title: 门前的卫兵
zh.description: 两名穿红黄蓝条纹制服的卫兵站在拱门与岗亭旁。

en.title: Bronze by the Colonnade
en.description: A dark bronze monument crowded with figures stands against the white colonnade.

zh.title: 柱廊前的铜像
zh.description: 深色青铜纪念碑挤满人形，背景是白色柱廊。

en.title: The Ceiling in a Mirror
en.description: A tilted mirror reflects a painted ceiling inside the dark church.

zh.title: 镜子里看穹顶
zh.description: 斜放的镜面映出满是壁画的顶棚，远处的大殿留在暗处。

en.title: Crowded at the Trevi
en.description: Visitors crowd the turquoise water below the Trevi Fountain’s white sculptures.

zh.title: 许愿池前都是人
zh.description: 游客围着碧绿池水，白色雕像铺满背后的立面。

en.title: Road Between Pines
en.description: A narrow road runs through dry grass toward the horizon, tall umbrella pines on either side.

zh.title: 松间土路
zh.description: 一条窄路穿过干草地向远处延伸，两旁立着高大的伞松。

en.title: Field After Harvest
en.description: Round hay bales sit scattered across a golden stubble field under a pale sky.

zh.title: 收割后的田野
zh.description: 收割后的金色田野上散落着圆形干草垛，天光灰白。

en.title: Spanish Steps
en.description: The wide stone steps climb to the twin-towered church, visitors resting on the treads.

zh.title: 西班牙台阶
zh.description: 宽阔的石阶通向双塔教堂，游客坐在台阶上休息。

en.title: Light from the Oculus
en.description: The coffered concrete dome opens to a round eye of sky, its light pooling on the wall.

zh.title: 天窗之光
zh.description: 网格状混凝土穹顶中央开着一个圆洞，光斑落在墙上。

en.title: Beach at Low Tide
en.description: At low tide a sand path emerges, leading across the beach to the fort on its rock.

zh.title: 退潮后的滩涂
zh.description: 退潮后沙路露出水面，一直通向礁石上的古堡。

en.title: Diving Platform in the Sea
en.description: A diving platform stands in the seawater pool, with people in and beside it.

zh.title: 海里的跳水台
zh.description: 跳水台立在海水泳池里，岸边与水中都有人。

en.title: Red Below the Diving Platform
en.description: A red-clad figure stands on the shore below the diving platform.

zh.title: 跳台前的红色身影
zh.description: 跳水台立在海中，红色身影留在近处岸边。

en.title: Beyond the Tall Grass
en.description: Tall reeds fill the foreground, the island town rising behind them.

zh.title: 长草尽头的山
zh.description: 高高的草秆后面，海那边的山岛上叠着房屋和塔尖。

en.title: One Sheep in the Grass
en.description: A pale sheep stands alone in a monochrome field.

zh.title: 草地里只剩一只羊
zh.description: 黑白草地里，一只浅色的羊站在画面中间。

en.title: Walking Toward the Mount
en.description: A figure in dark clothing crosses the grass toward the distant island town.

zh.title: 走向山城的人
zh.description: 穿深色外套的人穿过草场，朝地平线上的山城走去。

en.title: A Pause Before Mont-Saint-Michel
en.description: A person in white trousers pauses in the grass before Mont-Saint-Michel.

zh.title: 停在圣米歇尔山前
zh.description: 穿白裤子的人站在草地边，远处山城的塔尖指向天空。

en.title: Bridge Across the Channels
en.description: Walkers form a fine line on the bridge across winding tidal channels.

zh.title: 桥走过水道
zh.description: 弯曲水道分开滩涂，行人沿长桥排成一条细线。

en.title: A Moon in the Nave
en.description: A model moon hangs in the nave, coloured light falling on the columns.

zh.title: 殿中悬月
zh.description: 一颗大月亮模型吊在教堂中殿，柱子上落着彩色的光。

en.title: The Cloister Green
en.description: Paired stone columns ring the arcade around a small green courtyard.

zh.title: 回廊与草庭
zh.description: 成对的石柱撑起一圈拱廊，中间的庭院铺满青草。

en.title: Blue in the Stone Hall
en.description: A blue installation sits behind wooden barriers in the tall stone hall.

zh.title: 石厅里的蓝色
zh.description: 石柱围着长厅，高窗下的蓝色装置被木栏围住。

en.title: Yellow Robe, Stained Glass
en.description: A yellow-robed statue stands before a narrow stained-glass window.

zh.title: 黄袍像与彩窗
zh.description: 一尊黄袍雕像站在窄高的彩窗前，四周很暗。

en.title: Statue Before Stained Glass
en.description: A robed statue stands with its back to the camera before painted windows.

zh.title: 彩窗与背影
zh.description: 雕像背对镜头立着，背后是整面绘着人物的彩色玻璃。

en.title: People on the Balcony
en.description: People stand on a pale building’s balcony, with the moon above the roof.

zh.title: 阳台上的几个人
zh.description: 浅色楼房的阳台上站着几个人，月亮还在屋顶上方。

en.title: The Street Performer’s Patch

zh.description: 深色山体压在田野上方，山脚散落着几座小房子。

en.title: White Statue Among the Trees
en.description: A white statue stands on a tall column among dark branches.

zh.title: 白色立像留在树间
zh.description: 白色立像立在高柱顶端，深色枝杈围在四周。

en.title: View from the Lift
en.description: Snowy ridgelines stretch out under a blue sky beside the lift.

zh.title: 索道上望
zh.description: 从索道边望出去，积雪的山脊在蓝天下连成一片。

en.title: Mountain in Deep Blue
en.description: The slope sinks into deep blue, snow patches faintly visible.

zh.title: 深蓝的山
zh.description: 山体浸在深蓝色天光里，只剩残雪和裸岩隐约可见。

en.title: Dotted Ski Slope
en.description: Tiny skiers scatter across a wide slope beneath a rocky ridge.

zh.title: 一坡滑雪者
zh.description: 宽阔的雪道上散布着许多小小的滑雪者身影。

en.title: Edge of the Resort
en.description: Lifts, signs and chalets cluster at the edge of a groomed piste.

zh.title: 雪场一角
zh.description: 缆车、指示牌和成排木屋挤在滑雪场的缓坡边上。

en.title: Tracks in the Bowl
en.description: Ski tracks crisscross a wide bowl, its shadows turning blue.

zh.title: 雪谷轨迹
zh.description: 开阔的雪谷里留满滑行的轨迹，背光处的阴影发蓝。

en.title: Long Gentle Slope
en.description: Gentle snowfields run to the horizon with a few lift lines.

zh.title: 缓坡索道
zh.description: 平缓的雪坡一直铺到远处，几处索道架在山坡上。

en.title: Chalet and Two Skiers
en.description: Two skiers, one in red, one small in blue, stand before a timber chalet.

zh.title: 木屋前两人
zh.description: 全木结构的旅馆前，红衣大人和小孩并排站在雪地上。

en.title: Poles Along the Slope
en.description: Marker poles line the slope above a valley between snowy peaks.

zh.title: 坡边标杆
zh.description: 雪坡边缘立着一排标杆，远处山谷弯向群山之间。

en.title: Sky Meets Snow
en.description: Low cloud blurs the line between the slope and the sky.

zh.title: 低云压坡
zh.description: 云雾压得很低，雪坡和天空几乎分不清界限。

en.title: One Skier Descending
en.description: A lone skier heads downhill under faint lift pylons in the haze.

zh.title: 独自下滑
zh.description: 一个滑雪者正从坡上下来，头顶隐约可见索道的支架。

en.title: Ridge in the Fog
en.description: Only a dark ridgeline shows through the thick white fog.

zh.title: 雾中山脊
zh.description: 浓雾里只露出一线深色的山脊，四下皆白。

en.title: Figures Near the Lift
en.description: A few figures move about near the lift, red poles planted in snow.

zh.title: 索道旁的人
zh.description: 索道设施附近的雪地上有几个人在走动，身旁立着红色标杆。

en.title: Red Dots on the Slope
en.description: Skiers dot the slope below the lift line and low cloud.

zh.title: 红点沿山坡排开
zh.description: 滑雪者沿着索道下方的雪坡散开，远处是低云。

en.title: Fence in the Snow
en.description: Two figures sit in the snow beside a long fence on the slope.

zh.title: 栅栏边歇脚
zh.description: 长栅栏横在山腰的雪地里，两个人坐在栅栏边的雪上。

en.title: Rock Among the White
en.description: A small rocky peak rises from the snow below heavy cloud.

zh.title: 白色里露一点岩石
zh.description: 一座露出岩石的小峰立在雪地里，天空被厚云遮住。

en.title: Two in a Wide Snowfield
en.description: Two tiny figures cross a broad snowfield beneath low cloud.

zh.title: 两个人在大片雪里
zh.description: 大片雪地与低云接在一起，中间留着两个很小的人影。

en.title: Peaks Beyond the Markers
en.description: Two dark marker posts stand before snowy mountains softened by mist.

zh.title: 标杆后面的雪山
zh.description: 两根深色标杆立在近处，雪山的轮廓被雾气淡去。

en.title: Red Wood Below the Eaves
en.description: Red timber railings run below a snow-covered roof.

zh.title: 红木栏杆与屋檐
zh.description: 从低处看，红色木栏杆沿着积雪屋檐铺开。

en.title: Black Statue Before the Snow
en.description: A black statue stands beside the road below snowy slopes and trees.

zh.title: 雪山前的黑色立像
zh.description: 黑色雕像立在路边，背后是雪坡与树林。

en.title: Village Street Under Peaks
en.description: A plowed street curves between buildings toward a pointed snowy summit.

zh.title: 山间村道
zh.description: 积雪的村道两旁是楼房，道路尽头立着一座尖峭雪峰。

en.title: Dogs Across the Snow
en.description: People walk dogs across the snow, with resort buildings beneath the mountains.

zh.title: 带狗穿过雪地
zh.description: 几个人带着狗走过雪地，雪场建筑留在远处山下。

en.title: Wide View of the Slopes
en.description: Broad pistes run between snowy ridges above a valley of small buildings.

zh.title: 宽阔雪道
zh.description: 两侧雪山夹出宽阔雪道，远处谷底能看见散落的建筑。

en.title: Miniature Lights Behind Glass
en.description: Colourful miniature structures glow in the dark behind reflective glass.

zh.title: 玻璃里的微型灯火
zh.description: 彩色微型建筑亮在暗处，玻璃上叠着反光。

en.title: Bon Voyage Window
en.description: Behind a painted blue frame, two people look out at the lake.

zh.title: 彩绘窗框
zh.description: 画着鱼和海浪的蓝框窗后，两个人影正望向湖面。

en.title: Small Boat, Far Shore
en.description: A tiny boat sits on open water with mountains lining the far shore.

zh.title: 远处小船
zh.description: 开阔湖面上有一只很小的船影，对岸山脉淡淡排开。

en.title: People on the Rocks
en.description: Several people rest on a rocky point beside a signposted pole.

zh.title: 石上歇脚
zh.description: 几个人围坐在湖边的大石头上，旁边立着带标志的杆子。

en.title: Birds on the Lake
en.description: Waterbirds dot the lake beyond horizontal wooden rails.

zh.title: 湖面上的鸟群
zh.description: 湖面上散着许多水鸟，近处的木栏横过水面。

en.title: Two Beneath the Willow
en.description: Two people sit on a lakeside bench beneath fine willow branches.

zh.title: 垂柳下坐两个人
zh.description: 两个人坐在湖边长椅上，垂柳的细枝落在上方。

en.title: Two Sculpted Figures
en.description: Two sculpted figures stand on a tall base above grass and trees.

zh.title: 草丛上的双人雕像
zh.description: 双人雕像立在高高的基座上，草丛与树围在下方。

en.title: Another Statue Among the Trees
en.description: Light catches a dark statue’s raised arm among the trees.

zh.title: 树间的另一座雕像
zh.description: 一座深色雕像立在树间，光照到它抬起的手臂。

en.title: Station Above the Ice
en.description: A blue train waits on the elevated track while people cross the icy plaza.

zh.title: 冰面车站
zh.description: 高架上的蓝白列车旁，行人正踩着结冰的地面前行。

en.title: Ice Before the Tower
en.description: People cross the frozen harbor near a tall tower and a moored ship.

zh.title: 塔楼下的冰面
zh.description: 结冰的水面上人来人往，远处立着高塔和白色大船。

en.title: Long Shadow on the Ice
en.description: A walker casts a long blue shadow across ice dotted with distant figures.

zh.title: 冰上的长影子
zh.description: 一个人走过冰面，蓝色长影子伸向画面外，远处还有许多人。

en.title: Skaters Against the Sun
en.description: Low sun turns the skaters into silhouettes before a distant chimney.

zh.title: 逆光冰场
zh.description: 太阳压得很低，冰上的人都成了剪影，远处有一根烟囱。

en.title: Hand in Hand on Skates
en.description: Two people hold hands on skates before rooftops and a church spire.

zh.title: 牵手滑过冰面
zh.description: 两个人牵手站在冰上，远处教堂尖塔高过楼房。

en.title: Hockey Sticks by the Ship
en.description: Skaters with hockey sticks gather on the ice beside the old waterfront.

zh.title: 岸边球杆
zh.description: 黄色老楼前的冰面上，几个人握着球杆，白船就泊在岸边。

en.title: Waiting Underground
en.description: Passengers wait on the underground platform beside a train on curved tracks.

zh.title: 地铁站里等一等
zh.description: 乘客在地下站台等候，列车沿着弯曲轨道停靠。

en.title: Horses in the Paddock
en.description: Horses graze and wander inside a fence below a green hillside.

zh.title: 围栏里的马
zh.description: 木围栏里几匹马在吃草或走动，背后是满坡的绿色和房屋。

en.title: Facing the Pointed Peak
en.description: A figure stands in the grass looking across the lake at a pointed peak.

zh.title: 看山的人
zh.description: 一个人站在草坡上，望着脚下的湖水和对面尖顶的山。

en.title: Green Valley Below the Peaks
en.description: The meadow blurs in the foreground while green slopes rise to gray summits.

zh.title: 青山谷地
zh.description: 草坡从眼前掠过，远处深绿山谷尽头露出灰白色的山脊。

en.title: Cemetery in the Mountain Village
en.description: Rows of graves and flowers sit before the village beneath overhanging branches.

zh.title: 山村里的墓园
zh.description: 整齐墓碑与花束排在村庄前面，树枝从画面上方伸进来。

en.title: Peak Over the Valley
en.description: The pyramid peak rises over a green valley and a small village.

zh.title: 谷底的村子
zh.description: 金字塔峰下，绿谷尽头散着几排木屋屋顶。

en.title: Snow Peaks from the Passage
en.description: A dark passage opens onto snowy peaks above a snow-covered floor.

zh.title: 从暗处看雪山
zh.description: 深色通道的开口框住一排雪山，近处地面也积着雪。

en.title: Reflection in the Lake
en.description: The peak and its reflection meet in a still shallow lake.

zh.title: 湖中倒影
zh.description: 平静的浅水里映着完整的金字塔峰。

en.title: Snowman on the Slope
en.description: A squat snowman stands in the snow, the pointed peak behind.

zh.title: 雪人
zh.description: 矮胖的雪人立在雪地里，背后是金字塔峰。

en.title: One Standing, One Seated
en.description: Two people share a rocky ledge, with the snowy peak between them.

zh.title: 岩石上一站一坐
zh.description: 两个人在褐色岩石上一站一坐，雪峰刚好留在中间。

en.title: Patchy Snow Slope
en.description: Melting snow streaks the gravel slope below the pointed peak.

zh.title: 残雪坡
zh.description: 融雪的碎石坡一路伸向金字塔峰脚下。

en.title: Summit Station
en.description: A red train waits at the summit station as visitors gather nearby.

zh.title: 山顶车站
zh.description: 红色列车停靠山顶站房，旅客聚在站台。

en.title: Cairn and the Matterhorn
en.description: A cairn stands beside the snow with the Matterhorn rising behind it.

zh.title: 石堆与马特洪峰
zh.description: 近处石堆立在雪地边，马特洪峰在后方尖尖地升起。

en.title: Train Around the Bend
en.description: The red train rounds a curve past the mountain station buildings.

zh.title: 盘山列车
zh.description: 红色列车沿弯道驶过站舍，远处雪山连绵。

en.title: Overlooking the Valley
en.description: A blond person stands on a boulder above the deep green valley.

zh.title: 崖边远眺
zh.description: 金发的人站在岩头，脚下是深谷与松林。

en.title: The Long Ridge
en.description: A long grassy ridge runs toward a wall of pale jagged peaks.

zh.title: 绿脊尽头
zh.description: 缓长的草坡尽头，灰白色尖峰成排立起。

en.title: Rocky Crest
en.description: A broken rocky crest leads up to a sheer grey spire.

zh.title: 岩棱
zh.description: 碎石棱线一路通向直立的灰色尖峰。

en.title: Figure on the Hilltop
en.description: A small figure stands on the grassy crest beside a steep rock wall.

zh.title: 坡顶的人
zh.description: 小小人影站在草坡顶，旁边是陡直的岩壁。

en.title: Flowers Below the Mountains
en.description: Yellow flowers fill the blue-green foreground below huts and high mountain walls.

zh.title: 花开在山脚下
zh.description: 黄花与蓝绿色草地铺满近处，木屋留在高大岩壁下面。

en.title: Paraglider Over Green Hills
en.description: A green paraglider drifts above soft hills folding into the valley.

zh.title: 滑翔伞
zh.description: 绿色滑翔伞掠过山脊，草坡缓缓铺向谷底。

en.title: Path Through the Valley
en.description: Two walkers follow the gravel path into the broad green valley.

zh.title: 谷中小路
zh.description: 两个人影沿碎石小路走向山谷深处。

en.title: Small Paragliders in the Sky
en.description: Small colourful paragliders hang above rocky ridges and green woods.

zh.title: 天上的几颗小伞
zh.description: 几颗彩色滑翔伞悬在蓝天里，下方是岩壁与绿林。

en.title: The Grassy Footpath
en.description: A lone walker pauses on the grassy path below a jagged peak.

zh.title: 草径独行者
zh.description: 独行的人站在草径上，背后尖峰带着残雪。

en.title: Moon Over Bare Rock
en.description: A small daytime moon hangs above the pale rocky ridge.

zh.title: 白昼的月
zh.description: 浅金色岩坡上方，蓝天里挂着一小轮月亮。

en.title: Barn Below the Cliffs
en.description: An old barn sits on the green slope beneath pale rocky summits.

zh.title: 坡下木屋
zh.description: 草坡上一座旧木屋，背后压着灰白色岩山。

en.title: Two Sitting by the Water
en.description: Two people sit beside reflective water, with swimmers further out.

zh.title: 水边坐两个人
zh.description: 两个人背对镜头坐在水边，水面反着光，远处有人游泳。

en.title: Under the Big Trees
en.description: People rest on the grass in the shade of tall park trees.

zh.title: 大树底下
zh.description: 几棵大树的阴影里，人们散坐在草地上。

en.title: Light in the Dark Park
en.description: A patch of light falls on two people seated on the grass.

zh.title: 树荫深处
zh.description: 浓暗的树荫里，一束光落在并坐的两人身上。

en.title: Sunlight Through the Trees
en.description: Trees frame the bright lake around a figure in the waterside shade.

zh.title: 树把阳光筛下来
zh.description: 湖边树丛围住亮光，一个人影留在水边暗处。

en.title: A Pause by the Midsummer Pole
en.description: Four people pause at the white railing before a leafy midsummer pole.

zh.title: 仲夏柱前站一会儿
zh.description: 白栏杆边站着四个人，前方的仲夏柱挂着绿色枝叶。

en.title: Crowd by the Reeds
en.description: A crowd stands on grass facing tall reeds, backs to the camera.

zh.title: 苇边人群
zh.description: 人群背对镜头站在苇草前的草地上。

en.title: Two Bonfires Burning
en.description: Two bonfires burn among trees, smoke rising past onlookers.

zh.title: 两堆篝火
zh.description: 林间点起两堆篝火，烟往上升。

en.title: Watching Fire From Shore
en.description: A shoreline crowd faces fire and smoke out on the water.

zh.title: 岸上看火
zh.description: 人群挤在湖岸，看水面上的火光与烟。

en.title: Fire on the Water
en.description: A single fire burns on the open water, its reflection stretching below.

zh.title: 水面篝火
zh.description: 一堆火在水中央燃着，倒影很长。

en.title: Wheel on a Tall Pole
en.description: Figures gather beneath a tall pole topped with a circular wheel.

zh.title: 轮圈杆下
zh.description: 天色将暗，人影聚在一根顶着轮圈的杆下。

en.title: Wooden Frame on the Grass
en.description: A wooden swing frame stands on grass where adults and children gather.

zh.title: 草地木架
zh.description: 草地上立着木制秋千架，大人和孩子各自活动。

en.title: Boat by the Rocky Shore
en.description: A small boat sits near a rocky, tree-lined shore framed by branches.

zh.title: 岩岸小舟
zh.description: 岩石湖岸上树影错落，近岸漂着一条小船。

en.title: Two at the White Railing
en.description: Two people face the water at a white railing, one carrying red embroidery.

zh.title: 白栏边看水
zh.description: 两人站在白栏杆旁看水，其中一人背着红色刺绣的包。

en.title: Pink Left in the Sky
en.description: Railings and a wheel stand in silhouette against pink sky and water.

zh.title: 天边还留着粉色
zh.description: 栏杆和轮架成了剪影，粉色天空映在水面。

en.title: The Dog Goes for a Swim
en.description: A dog swims through the rippled water, only its head showing.

zh.title: 狗也来游泳了
zh.description: 满幅波纹里，一只狗露着头游过水面。
